root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ContactTypesTbl WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier') BEGIN INSERT INTO dbo.ContactTypesTbl (ContactTypeDesc) VALUES (N'Supplier'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'SupplierCollectionContactTypeID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl ADD SupplierCollectionContactTypeID INT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'SupplierCollectionContactTypeID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN DECLARE @SupplierTypeId INT = ( SELECT TOP 1 ContactTypeID FROM dbo.ContactTypesTbl WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier' ORDER BY ContactTypeID); IF @SupplierTypeId IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl WHERE SettingsID = 1) UPDATE dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl SET SupplierCollectionContactTypeID = @SupplierTypeId WHERE SettingsID = 1 AND SupplierCollectionContactTypeID IS NULL; UPDATE dbo.ContactsTbl SET ContactTypeID = NULL WHERE ContactTypeID = @SupplierTypeId AND CompanyName LIKE N'%Cape Coffee Beans%';
UPDATE dbo.ContactsTbl SET ContactTypeID = @SupplierTypeId WHERE ContactTypeID IS NULL OR ContactTypeID <> @SupplierTypeId AND ( CompanyName LIKE N'%Zuka%' OR CompanyName LIKE N'%Marunic%' OR CompanyName LIKE N'%Float%' OR (CompanyName LIKE N'%Cape Coffee%' AND CompanyName NOT LIKE N'%Beans%') ); END END
